offering_description.value: Flowco sells and rents artificial lift, gas compression, and vapor recovery equipment to oil and gas producers. It designs and builds equipment and provides installation, maintenance, and remote monitoring to help operators keep wells producing and capture gas that would otherwise escape.

primary_products.value: High-pressure and conventional gas lift systems; plunger lift systems; natural gas compressors; vapor recovery units; well monitoring and control systems

primary_services.value: Equipment rental; field installation and maintenance; remote equipment monitoring; well production optimization

customer_segment.value: B2B: Oil and natural gas producers and well operators

end_markets.value: Onshore oil and natural gas production

revenue_model.value: rental or leasing: Artificial lift, gas compression, and vapor recovery equipment deployed at well sites; product sales: Artificial lift systems, compressors, vapor recovery units, and replacement parts; service fees: Field installation, maintenance, and production optimization
revenue_model.category: rental or leasing; product sales; service fees

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: Builds artificial lift, compression, and vapor recovery equipment from purchased components for oil and gas operators; asset operator: Owns and maintains a fleet of compressors and vapor recovery units deployed at customer sites; service provider: Uses well performance data and field crews to install, maintain, and optimize equipment for producers
value_chain_position.category: OEM / manufacturer; asset operator; service provider

geography_served.value: US national: Major onshore U.S. oil and gas basins, including the Permian Basin

specialization.value: related lines: Artificial lift, natural gas compression, vapor recovery, and well monitoring

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: Sales and field service teams serving oil and gas operators

regulatory_exposure.value: medium: EPA and state air emissions rules affect wellsite compression and vapor recovery, OSHA rules apply to manufacturing and field work.

notes: The extent of operations outside the United States is uncertain.
